blurb: Turn from the light: the fallen rise again at your call, and every heresy you commit makes them stronger, and you hungrier. Only penance, paid in bodies, washes it away.
name: Devil Forgemaster
notes: In game (hwp_priest_forgemaster, tested): the subclass in mods/specs (players/hwp/specs/class_specs.sval, Forgemaster.as; the risen and body units are generated by tools/make_forgemaster_risen.py). Every skill and orb is checked by plan-forgemaster 20261022-102006 and plan-forgemaster-bosses 20261022-084131. Not balanced yet. Heresy is its own stack, separate from Divine Favor. Raising the dead adds Heresy (normal +1, elite +2, boss +3); at 5 Heresy you can no longer raise. Heresy powers your summons and risks a flesh-eating lunge. At max Divine Favor, Necrotic Resurrection becomes Sacrificial Penance (its own name, icon and effect): sacrifice an intact body to remove Heresy. Choosing this spec gives Divine Favor level 1 for free. Gaining Favor does not lower Heresy.
